title: Hey Noahとは？｜先回りするAI秘書の価値と代理送信リスク
description: 予定調整、会議準備、フォローアップ、電話を行うAI秘書Hey Noahの仕組みと、代理行為・個人情報・相手側負担の注意点を解説します。
answer: Hey Noahは、予定調整、会議準備、フォローアップ、電話などを先回りして進めるAIエグゼクティブ秘書です。便利さの裏側で、本人名義の誤送信、誤予約、機密情報、相手への反復連絡が信用リスクになります。導入は社内の候補作成と下書きから始め、対外送信・予約・費用発生には人の承認を残すべきです。
keyPoints: SMSやメールへのCCから予定調整やフォローアップを進める設計です。
依頼待ちではなく、返信待ちや会議後の行動を先回りして追跡します。
カレンダー、連絡先、会議メモは経営上の機密になり得ます。
本人の時間短縮だけでなく、連絡を受ける相手の負担も評価対象です。
専用アカウント、対象者限定、人の送信承認から段階的に導入します。
transcript: Hey Noahは予定と人間関係が仕事の中心になる創業者、投資家、経営者向けのAI秘書です。予定調整、会議準備、フォローアップ、電話までを先回りして進めます。
重要な人間関係ほど緊急業務に押し流されます。日程候補、返信確認、会議後の次の約束という細かな仕事をAIへ渡そうとする製品です。
SMSで一言伝えたり、メールのやり取りへNoahをCCしたりすると、カレンダー確認、候補提示、相手との調整、予定登録へ進むと説明されています。
従来のチャットAIが聞かれた時に答えるのに対し、会議後の行動項目、返信待ち、次の会議準備を先回りして追跡する点が特徴です。
会議前の相手情報は、古い情報や別人の情報が混ざると信頼を損ないます。出典と最終更新日を示し、人が短時間で確認できる形が必要です。
電話や代理送信では、本人の利便性が受け手の負担になる可能性があります。AI利用の明示、反復連絡の停止条件、人への切替を用意します。
本人名義でのメール、予約、取消、費用発生は本物の関係へ影響します。実行直前の人間承認と、失敗時の停止条件が必要です。
カレンダー、会議メモ、連絡先、過去の会話から採用、投資、買収、商談の兆候が分かる場合があります。接続先、保存期間、学習利用、削除方法、閲覧権限を確認します。
評価は依頼者の時間短縮だけでは足りません。相手へ届いた確認回数、誤予約の訂正時間、拒否後に止まったかという外部負担も測ります。
日本企業では社内の日程候補とフォローアップ下書きから始め、専用アカウント、限定対象、人の送信承認を置きます。電話と費用発生は最後の段階です。
どのAIが誰の代理で、何の目的で連絡し、どこまで確定できるかを相手に示します。AIのID、代理者、権限期限、監査ログ、停止窓口を結ぶことが信頼につながります。

faq.question: Hey Noahとは何ですか？
faq.answer: 予定調整、会議準備、フォローアップ、電話などを、依頼待ちではなく先回りして支援するAIエグゼクティブ秘書です。

faq.question: AI秘書を安全に導入するには？
faq.answer: 社内向け候補作成と下書きから始め、専用アカウントと限定権限を使い、対外送信、予約、取消、費用発生の直前に人が承認します。

faq.question: AI秘書では何のデータに注意が必要ですか？
faq.answer: カレンダー、連絡先、会議メモ、過去の会話は経営・人事・商談上の機密になり得るため、保存先、利用目的、保持期間、削除方法を確認します。

en.title: What is Hey Noah? A proactive AI chief of staff, and the delegation risk
en.description: How the AI assistant Hey Noah handles scheduling, meeting prep, follow-up and calls — and what to watch for around acting on your behalf, personal data, and the burden it puts on the other side.
en.answer: Hey Noah is an AI executive assistant that works ahead of you on scheduling, meeting preparation, follow-up and phone calls. Behind the convenience sit reputational risks: messages sent wrongly in your name, mistaken bookings, confidential information, and repeated contact with the people on the other end. Introduce it starting from internal drafting and candidate slots, and keep a human approval step before anything is sent externally, booked, or costs money.
keyPoints: It is designed to pick up scheduling and follow-up from a text message or from being CC'd on email.
Rather than waiting to be asked, it tracks awaited replies and post-meeting actions in advance.
Calendars, contacts and meeting notes can be commercially confidential.
Evaluate not only the time you save but the burden placed on the people being contacted.
Roll it out in stages: a dedicated account, a limited set of recipients, and human approval before sending.
transcript: Hey Noah is an AI assistant for founders, investors and executives whose work centres on their schedule and their relationships. It works ahead on scheduling, meeting preparation, follow-up and even phone calls.

The more important a relationship, the more easily it gets pushed aside by urgent work. The product tries to hand the small work — proposing slots, checking for replies, setting the next commitment after a meeting — to an AI.

The description is that you send a short text, or CC Noah on an email thread, and it moves on to checking your calendar, offering slots, negotiating with the other party, and putting the meeting in your diary.

Where a conventional chat AI answers when asked, this one is distinguished by tracking action items after a meeting, replies you are waiting on, and preparation for the next meeting, ahead of being told.

Briefing material about the other party before a meeting damages trust if stale information or the wrong person's details get mixed in. It needs to show its sources and last-updated dates in a form a human can check quickly.

With phone calls and messages sent on your behalf, your convenience can become the recipient's burden. Disclose that an AI is involved, set stopping conditions for repeated contact, and provide a route to a human.
Email, bookings, cancellations and spending in your own name affect real relationships. You need human approval immediately before execution, and a stopping condition for when it goes wrong.

Calendars, meeting notes, contacts and past conversations can reveal signs of hiring, investment, acquisitions or deals in progress. Check what it connects to, how long data is retained, whether it is used for training, how to delete it, and who can read it.

Evaluating it on the requester's time saved is not enough. Also measure the external burden: how many confirmations reached the other party, how long it took to correct a mistaken booking, and whether it actually stopped after being declined.

In a Japanese company, start with internal candidate slots and follow-up drafts, using a dedicated account, a limited set of recipients, and human approval before sending. Phone calls and anything that costs money come last.

Tell the other side which AI is acting for whom, for what purpose, and how far it can commit. Connecting the AI's identity, the person it represents, the expiry of its authority, the audit log and a route to stop it is what builds trust.

faq.question: What is Hey Noah?
faq.answer: An AI executive assistant that supports scheduling, meeting preparation, follow-up and phone calls proactively, rather than waiting to be asked.

faq.question: How do you introduce an AI assistant safely?
faq.answer: Start with internal candidate slots and drafts, use a dedicated account with limited permissions, and have a human approve immediately before anything is sent externally, booked, cancelled or paid for.

faq.question: What data needs care with an AI assistant?
faq.answer: Calendars, contacts, meeting notes and past conversations can be confidential for management, HR or deals, so check where they are stored, why they are used, how long they are kept and how to delete them.
